descriptions.w3d_type_list_80241af4: Returns the registry that tracks every live object of this engine type.
descriptions.w3d_type_create_80241b00: Allocates and constructs a new object of this type, adds it to the type registry and increments the live count.
descriptions.w3d_type_unlink_80241b68: Removes the object from its type registry and decrements the registry's live count.
descriptions.w3d_type_destroy_80241e4c: Destroys an object of this type, releasing its members and base part; frees the memory when flag bit 0 is set.
